text: Heb. by the hand of. , Heb. the talnesse, &c. , Or, the forrest and his fruitful field
Or, hast thou not heard how I haue made it long agoe, and formed it of ancient times? should I now bring it to be laide waste, and fenced cities to be ruinous heapes?
Hebr. the escaping of the house of Iudah that remaineth.
